title: Text: DET Jordan Zimmermann ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Can you give me the cliff’s notes version of how you spotted this change in Norris’ delivery? Like, when, how (live/video), etc.
Sorry I got a new phone. Who is this?
Found out with my own eyes
When did you put this in motion, he mentioned he said “fix me” to you or something

I noticed it a while back but I knew he was dealing with groin issues. So I figured when he got healthy and came back he would get back to where he used to be. Then when I saw him throwing off the mound this spring I saw that his mechanics didn’t change. So when he asked me to “fix him”. I said let’s go to the video room and I showed him what I saw and what I thought he had to do to fix it. So it was up to him to take it and go with it and I think he has done just that. He has a little was to go yet but he has taken a big stride and I’m excited to see what he can do with the new fix.
Rick Anderson also helped with the fix as he was Working with Norris on that before the groin injury happened and then he got away from it because of the groin
So really Rick saw it before me and then it happened I saw the same thing after surgery
So rick saw the fix and worked with Dino before surgery and then he had surgery and got away from it and then I saw the same thing so we both saw the same thing before and after surgery
Got it. Thanks for getting back to me
I just don’t want rick to be left out of the article because he was a big part of it as well
Because you’re def getting the headlines
Yea I want Andy to get a bunch too
